item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00205","case1_error":"Reverses the twice-as-many relation, multiplying Emmy’s remaining eight by two instead of dividing to find Rosa’s count.","case2_error":"Treats one student’s 105 pens as the entire pool, omitting multiplication by three students.","reason":"The first reverses a comparative relation; the second confuses a per-student amount with the pooled total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00206","case1_error":"Gives unsupported 74 without numerical calculations; the stated average also leaves arithmetic versus time-weighted averaging unclear.","case2_error":"Treats ten hours over five days as ten hours per day, omitting division by five.","reason":"The first question leaves the averaging interpretation materially ambiguous; the second clearly misinterprets a multiday total as a daily rate.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00207","case1_error":"Omits Ted’s four eaten cookies, reporting the amount remaining after only Frank’s consumption.","case2_error":"Incorrectly defines total spending as skates cost plus remaining money, rather than initial money minus remaining money.","reason":"The first omits a specified consumption; the second constructs an erroneous relation for total spending.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00208","case1_error":"Uses the original nine T-shirts as the tripling base; the question’s comparison wording leaves that base ambiguous.","case2_error":"Calculates jewelry spending without subtracting the earlier sweater purchase from the initial money.","reason":"The first depends on an ambiguous comparison base, preventing a clear error diagnosis. The second clearly omits an earlier expenditure.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00209","case1_error":"Counts each two-dozen set as twelve cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Correctly finds ten cakes remaining, then reports fifty already baked as the number still needed.","reason":"The first omits a factor in calculating the total; the second answers the complementary quantity after correctly finding the requested one.","judgment":"different"}]}
